notes.title: 💙 VERSION 1.0 IS COMING!!🚀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/3d7d7917a753122eeec6d55d55a051aa760eff71.png[/img]

[h1]💙RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT!!🚀[/h1]

Version 1.0 will be coming to your rooftop on [b]NOVEMBER 13th![/b]

Watch our devlog to see what's coming in our biggest update yet 👇

[previewyoutube=MCpwjJQl578;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]TEXT VERSION OF THE UPDATE: [/h2]

[h3]Story[/h3]
At last, you’ll be able to complete the story, discover what happened to Cosmopolis and our hero, and make an important choice!

[h3]New Rooftops[/h3]
Remember all those "coming soon" zones? Well now, you’ll be able to visit all the rooftops you’ve been curious about, plus we’ve added several bigger new locations!

[h3]The Carnival[/h3]
We know you’ve all been eagerly waiting to visit the carnival since we last showed it off, and it will finally be accessible with this new update!

[h3]A New Friend![/h3]
In the last update, we introduced the relationship system with characters, and of course, we’ve added a new character in version 1.0! Meet Bombshell Barbara - a woman with an “explosive” personality who needs your help! Befriend her, help her work through her problems, and she’ll make sure nobody messes with you!

[h3]New Smart Tower Levels[/h3]
We’ve added levels 3 and 4 of the Smart Tower, meaning you can now travel to every corner of Cosmopolis and visit all the previously locked locations! You’ll also be able to unlock new upgrade modules, including the weather control module, solar generator, and battery upgrades. And don’t forget the enhancements for minions, batteries, and tools. Get ready to explore!

[h3]Resource Progression[/h3]
As technology advances, so do production methods. We’ve added a third level for the press, along with a nano-forge - a new structure where you can create entirely new materials like techno-wood, tungsten, carbon, and reactors! And, of course, you can now finally fully upgrade all your tools to the max level!

[h3]Teleports[/h3]
The rooftop was already pretty big, and now it’s even bigger. Moving around has become a real issue, but we have a solution: teleportation. Place one here, place another there, and voilà! Now no one will be able to keep up, except maybe the game camera.

[h3]Farming, Fishing, and Cooking[/h3]
New plants and crops have arrived - cream beans and noodle grass. And you thought the cheese tree was the height of Cosmopolis agriculture? You can now upgrade the fishing rod to level 3 to catch four new, delightful post-apocalyptic fish. And with all these new ingredients, we’re thrilled to announce the arrival of the fourth and final level of the kitchen, along with dozens of new recipes for you to try.

[h3]Progression[/h3]
We’ve added all the missing structure levels: Level 2 and 3 for the Cultivator and UV Tower, Level 3 for the Bio-Generator, Crypto Farm, and anti-infection spray, and of course, Level 4 for the Barricade.

[h3]Recycling[/h3]
A few words about our latest addition: recycling. We’ve expanded resource recycling in the game, with dismantling options now available on the workbench, farmer’s table, and synthesizer, including levels 2 and 3. All your “spam” resources (we promise we didn’t mean for them to be spam) are now integrated into the broader resource system. Pre-created resources can also be broken down into their components.

notes.title: 'Relationship' Major Content Update! 💕
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, future-dwellers! [/h1]

Here's the update you’ve all been waiting for! At the Housewarming party, it didn't seem to go just as planned, so it's time to win back some trust and build more of a relationship with your fellow rooftop friends!

[h2]Explore a new rooftop[/h2]
We have a new roof - the Entertainment Zone! Hotel guests would swim, exercise, sing, dance, and watch movies. We've even added new themed items to dismantle. Keep exploring to find a new cosmetic item 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/cf1ab13e054cd02f11b6a4fe8ce8df49131604df.png[/img]

[h2]Continuation of the Main Storyline[/h2]
The long-awaited continuation of the main storyline is here but where could we go after the housewarming party? 
Now we have the answer for you. Although the story is not yet finished we do have some surprises waiting to keep you guessing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/1dbdc0ba5709607821c979dcb01fc33d60f87d5c.png[/img]

[h2]Relationships[/h2]
Develop relationships with your friends on the rooftop! After such a housewarming, it’s only natural that you'd want to cheer them up. As you develop relationships, you can give them gifts that you find on expeditions, play mini-games, and complete daily tasks! With each relationship level, new rewards will unlock for you.

The relationship system is our main focus for this update. We hope you will find it as exciting and fun to befriend a fridge as we did implementing it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/56846af14b2fb7449ff9da462723d3e67b837e53.png[/img]

[h2]Radio Module[/h2]
Have you wondered why you communicate through the Smart Tower? We have an answer: now you can. Every day, you will discover lost messages from the residents of flooded Cosmopolis every day. Some will even talk back like the Game Master! More characters will be communicating in the future, so check back often.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/df96231424d7dd19a5b5397a2cc66c13677a0f12.png[/img]

[h2]New Smart Tower Modules[/h2]
In this update, we’ve prepared a whole series of new modules. Starting with the long-awaited tool upgrades. Spend as little time as possible dismantling trash! 

Want to know the weather forecast? Install the weather forecast module.
Do your minions often run out of power? Increase their battery life! Speaking of our little helpers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9dd55ac06ea9265dc9fb62a8ea5dd70156a649d.png[/img]

[h2]Minions[/h2]
Speaking of our little robot minions, with every update, we give these cuties a significant dose of attention. We constantly work to improve the minion AI to make them smarter along with some new added features too:
[list]
[*] We have some new roles: The water carrier, aqua genius, and repairman. These minions will water the flower beds, refill the sprinklers, and repair your buildings.
[*] We’ve improved minion behavior and added statuses and custom routes.
[*] All minions, not just gatherers, can search for and collect resources from the ground. (It wasn't easy, but we finally did it!)  
[*] Idle minions will no longer waste energy.
[*] Last but not least, Minions will now complete tasks to the end! Sometimes, the goal is so far that the battery almost dies. Don’t worry - other minions have volunteered to help to the end and then go back to recharge.
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/a273201852669e1aac4884bb93b64eef83ef2326.png[/img]

[h2]And a Few More Small Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We redesigned the floor patches to look more plastic. Many players suggested they should be made of planks, but we have other ideas. And, trust us, carrying hundreds of planks for all the patches would be extremely tiring.
[*] New resource - reactor.
[*] There are three levels of repair kits with new models and animations. Repair minions also use them – be sure to check them out!
[*] The water storage barrel has become an essential element of gameplay. We have moved it to the regular storage category. We will return everything to those who managed to buy it with coupons.
[/list]

notes.title: 'Solar Energy' Major Content Update! 🚀
notes.content:
[h2]What’s new?[/h2]

[previewyoutube=MFTLwlQiTJk;full][/previewyoutube]
The new rooftop is available after completing the New Home quest. Exploring this rooftop will reveal the story of Muscle Claus, "the strongest" man in Cosmopolis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/66e7156b2154d1304666ac31713f987b039fdfef.jpg[/img]

[h3]Solar generator and battery 🌞[/h3]

Two structures that expand the game's electrical system. The solar generator operates without fuel but won't work at night or in dark weather. The battery helps preserve energy in the electrical grid, allowing for long-lasting autonomy. Together, they create a powerful grid that doesn't even need fuel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/06fff21d96187e06fccaaf045a8d669898c73331.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/db0d0dda269543376a96614f2cc9cb4a287a0d86.gif[/img]

[h3]New tools 🔧[/h3]

Level 3 drill and level 3 injector. These will help disassemble everything on the rooftop.
The automatic sprinkler and pump have been upgraded to level 3, and the water supply and irrigation system have received their long-awaited improvements.

[h3]Days of the week 📅[/h3]

A week cycle has been added to the game. It diversifies the expedition system, with many points of interest now only open on certain days of the week. Conversely, the rewards at these points have been increased. Also, traders do not work on certain days of the week. But where do they go? They replenish their inventory. Track the days when traders and points of interest are available in the new character menu tab - the Calendar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9e57d82e0ea5b0081bde4452ed2b6fe9da74b7e.gif[/img]

[h3]Weather ⛅[/h3]

Another feature introduced to diversify the world of I Am Future is the weather cycle. Currently, overcast and rainy weather has been created. Each affects the rooftop. Mushrooms even grow during overcast weather. In rainy weather, you don't need to water the plants; the barrels automatically fill with fresh water. Remember to pour the saltwater first, as they don't mix well. However, rainy weather is considered dark for the solar generator and won't charge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4aade83c6fdc5e35f7dd9ae16309cacdc5b9aecb.png[/img]

There is a new device to disassemble, but we suggest you find it yourself. Now, all devices that you disassemble may contain an unexpected find.

[h3]Wires across bridges and ladders ⚡[/h3]

Remember how often you wrote that electrical grids from different rooftops couldn't be connected? Now they can! We've added a system of electrical poles on all ladders and the bridge. You just need to install them.

[h3]A chest in the fishing area 🎁[/h3] 

Since everyone is tired of fishing trips, when you leave your rod at home, store it in the meta-network of chests and retrieve it even in the fishing zone. By the way, you can now build a special chest there. To avoid disassembling all household appliances on-site, they can now be lifted by an elevator.

[h3]Special bait for mollusks [/h3]

The second level of the fishing rod really expands the list of catches, which can negatively impact when you need to catch the most basic thing - mollusks. A special recipe at the workbench will create a bait that exclusively catches mollusks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4e603f737d0823daa868c6509370ee9c9bf71be6.png[/img]

[h3]Cheese tree and tomato 🧀 [/h3]

New rooftop - new plants. They expand the farming and cooking systems. Try 7 new recipes in our menu before the rest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/06d2c6dba0901ba54bfb189f754164a99f6900c3.gif[/img]

[h3]Sports suit  🏓[/h3]

The theme of the new rooftop is sports, so we had to add a sports suit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/73bb26c1f3589f14bd38657f20352a4492f9ff1e.gif[/img]

[h3]Crafting buckets 💧[/h3]

You can now craft as many buckets as you want at the workbench. They are more convenient to use than bottles.

[h3]A new navigation system for minions 🤖 [/h3]

This is a big step towards making them the most helpful helpers. The minion navigation system is a huge task, and, of course, it is not perfect yet, but it is now working much faster and making fewer mistakes. We will also give it special attention in a future update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/d914548547d38dc772697e57c77c2de79d97efbc.gif[/img]

[h3]New hints ❓ [/h3] 

We placed hints throughout all the systems in the game on the loading screen so they are no longer empty. They were selected based on your feedback, which we truly appreciate! One of the frequent issues not explained in the game is where Agatha's shop is located. Now, it is highlighted on the map of expeditions, even at the first level of the smart tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4839f96e45367064b60a909906a921aff11a3ba5.png[/img]

[h2]Additional fixes and improvements[/h2]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
Added a hydraulic press mechanic to the workbench for splitting resources
Added upgrades for pumps, allowing them to collect and desalinate water automatically
Traders' assortments are now updated periodically
Fixed the moving of the barricades in nano-transports
Removed the loading screen when moving to the fishing zone by elevator

[b]UI & Controls:[/b]
Improved gamepad control during the fishing
Improved the hint system for gamepads
Many UI and text fixes in the game
Made corrections to the control schemes for rotating the camera and large resources during the transportation 
Fish cutting can now be done continuously by holding down a button
Updated design of hints for points of interest in expeditions
Localization fixes in various languages

[b]Optimization:[/b]
Fixed many bugs
Improved game performance
Improved and sped up the save and load system
Fixed errors in the direction of electricity in wires
Fixed collider errors in many places

[b]Art:[/b]
Updated graphics for floor breaches
Added new unique illustrations for all points in expeditions
Many visual bug fixes

[b]Sound:[/b]
Fixed hologram sounds
Added sounds for the molecular synthesizer
Added sounds for healing
Added sounds for splitting resources
Added sounds for the infection flowers

notes.title: Questions with the developer! 💬
notes.content:
[h2]We're back again future-dwellers 🚀[/h2]

We have gathered the questions and are excited to answer them regarding the game's development and upcoming features! 🤖

You can watch the video on our YouTube channel or read the below Q&A now.

[previewyoutube=y4xl4TwyeI8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Here are the questions and answers from the developers:[/h2]

[h3][b]Q.1[/b] - Are there any plans for console ports?[/h3]
Yes, the game is planned to be released on all current-gen consoles in the future, probably on the 1.0 release or a bit later.

[h3][b]Q.2[/b] - What should we expect from the next part of the story?[/h3]
Well, I can't dive into details as it'll be a huge spoiler for you. You can expect new NPCs, diorama areas, and new rooftop areas for sure. Very cool NPCs really, I like them.

[h3][b]Q.3[/b] - What is the inspiration behind the designs of the tools and robots?[/h3]
There are a lot of things that inspire us in other media. Mostly movies like "Love, Death and Robots", "Finch" with Tom Hanks, etc.

[h3][b]Q.4[/b] - Will there be any new quests and a continuation of the story in the next update?[/h3]
Right now we are working on an updated roadmap. Maybe it's already available, I don't know when this video will be out. Our next update will be focused on the gamepad, new GUI system, and optimization together with some narrative items and some smaller things. After that in the next update, we'll release a big part of the rooftop, finally! We know you're waiting for it so much and working on it. In the next update, we'll release the next chapter of the story with another rooftop area as well.

[h3][b]Q.5[/b] - Will we ever get any sort of pets or new companions? [/h3]
It's not planned for near future updates, but I like this idea and we'll consider it for our next updates.

[h3][b]Q.6[/b] - If we met another survivor, could we play as them on another rooftop and have them meet?[/h3]
There is no online co-op in I Am Future and not planned yet

[h3][b]Q.7[/b] - What are the plans for the minion improvements?[/h3]
We're constantly working on minions and will continue for sure. Right now we're not happy with their AI and pathfinding and fixing it. Also, we're planning to add more minion rules, mostly for repetitive tasks and routines. But before adding it we'd like to fix current rules to make it more stable and optimised.

[h3][b]Q.8[/b] - Can we see more weather changes and seasons?[/h3]
We're planning a weather system in the near future. With solar panels, probably wind power. Seasons sounds also very good for the game, but not planned in production currently. We'll decide a bit later on how and when we could implement it.

[h3][b]Q.9[/b] - Are there any plans for a mechanic to enable us to destroy items we have too much of?[/h3]
Yes, we're planning to add such mechanics and also make all your resources more useful with new recipes, buildings, and mechanics.

[h3][b]Q.10[/b] - We would love to see “overgrown” decorations, are they planned for the next update?[/h3]
Hmm... We'll think about it for sure. Also, I like the idea of adding decorative plants to make our rooftops filled with more nature

[h3][b]Q.11[/b] - Will the molecular synthesizer conversion functions be expanded into more than just biomass to specific types of garbage?[/h3]
Yes, the molecular synthesizer will be updated with new features for sure.

[h3][b]Q.12[/b] - Is there an ETA on chest renaming?[/h3]
It's planned to be released in our next big update in February together with new UI systems and gamepad support

[h3][b]Q.13[/b] - Will it be possible to connect all levels on all the rooftops into one power grid?[/h3]
Yes! The main idea behind electricity is to provide you with all the tools to connect it to one big power grid. The problem currently is stairs and bridge, but we're planning improvement for it.

[h3][b]Q.14[/b] - Can we have a storage container in our fishing area to store fishing bait?[/h3]
Yes, it's already planned to add

[h3][b]Q.15[/b] - Will we eventually be able to fully automate water collection, filtration, and distribution?[/h3]
Yes, it's part of the routine, and minions fit well for this work. We already have pumps, an auto-watering building, so the only thing is to make a rule for minions to take the water from the pump and fill the sprinkler

[h3][b]Q.16[/b] - Are there plans for specializing the minions using slotted upgrades?[/h3]
We are planning to provide you with minions upgrades, but it'll be as part of buying new modules on a Smart Tower

[h3][b]Q.17[/b] - Will there be anything for wind power?[/h3]
It's planned after we add the weather system, yes.

[h3][b]Q.18[/b] - It would be great to have simple minigames in-game like playing cards with the minions! [/h3]
We like ideas about mini-games... Not planned for the near future as everybody is waiting for new rooftop areas, story chapters, etc, but we'll think about adding something a bit later. Our team is not so big, just about 15 people, so we have to prioritize things

[h3][b]Q.19[/b] - As the rooftop gets larger, traveling will take a long time, will there be equipment to make traveling easier?[/h3]
Yeah, it's gonna be a problem. We're planning to add teleport buildings to fix it

[h3][b]Q.20[/b] - Will we be able to traverse the ocean by boat and maybe get some deep sea creatures?[/h3]
It's not planned, but we'll add a lot more fish and sea creatures for sure

notes.title: 🚀 'A New Me' Content Update 💙
notes.content:
[h1]It's finally here future-dwellers! 🚀[/h1]

The holiday season is still celebrated even in a post-apocalyptic world! We are pleased to present you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/518a76488a47059bfd73e0a63c7f22259ed33655.gif[/img]

The team has been working tirelessly and reading [b]all of your requests[/b] of what content you want to see next [b]as well as improvements to our game[/b]. We are finally able to say, i[b]t's here and we can't wait for you all to play it.[/b]

[b]Make sure you don't miss our Christmas Event! We have some special presents waiting for you on our rooftop 🎁[/b]

This event runs from [b]Dec 21st - Jan 10th[/b] and all items you obtain will be [b]yours to keep forever[/b] so make sure you jump back to your rooftop and get these [b]limited-time items today[/b]

Check out our video here for all the details and what to expect 👇:

[previewyoutube=lQw02VuFaMI;full][/previewyoutube]
We've had a challenging year at Mandragora as we released our game into Early Access but [b]your positive feedback[/b] we've received from our amazing players has [b]kept us going.[/b] 

We're also working on [b]making the game compatible with gamepads, which will be available soon[/b]. We know this is a highly requested addition to our game and we're working on it as we speak but we just need a little more time. 

[h2][b][u]Major Content Updates:[/u][/b][/h2]

[h3][b]All new female character AND customization options[/b][/h3]

[b]The female character is now in the game right now![/b] You can only choose a character once per game, but we didn't want our long-time players to miss out on this exciting update. The first time you [b]click 'continue' on the main menu[/b], you will be presented with a choice! New players will see it [b]immediately when starting a new game.
[/b]
We've also added [b]more customization options[/b] to our editor, including skin color, hair, eyebrows, and beard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/82df3b298f784de422d44e482fce5013b55ae320.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New decorative buildings & mechanics[/b][/h3]

You'll love the new functional buildings that let you [b]nap in style, store tons of one-type resources, and tables[/b] that will allow you to arrange items or serve yourself lunch!

We also have [b]added new footpaths[/b] that can make your rooftop all that more unique to you and of course, cozy like you're on a small country farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/8e6b0b41a1f657aa1a6a43d0b72eebe6ec34568f.png[/img]

[h3][b]Color your rooftop![/b][/h3]

You can now [b]craft spray cans from leech slime[/b] and decorate all your buildings in various colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/ffed88be19476776979a276345fab17f4166560e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Blocking the infection nests[/b][/h3]

Annoyed by those pesky leeches from getting to your resources? We have [b]added a special dome that can block them[/b], just simply installed it on the huge flower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/1c4a2b76ed88d22ca5fea0518c895834222e92ba.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Rooftop Patches[/b][/h3]

Sealing holes in the floor is now available with special patches. [b]Once the floor is sealed, you can finally walk AND build[/b] on it so you know it's sturdy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/874215e48076e695c8f251be027c57e9a062c3f4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Introduction to 'mini-tasks' and new currency[/b][/h3]

We have added all new "mini-tasks" [b]Complete them to earn new currency[/b] which you can spend at a new store during expeditions to buy useful items and furniture blueprints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/adcdcc33d777a6e0450c2018319db334fa4c48d2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Christmas Event[/b][/h3]

Of course, we wanted to get you all into the holiday spirit with some gifts! Just [b]launch the game and you'll find them on your rooftop[/b], ready to bring some extra holiday cheer to your day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c50b280a3727d6023ecf277c1efc0374f7ff3e9d.png[/img]

notes.title: Q&A with the I Am Future Developers!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Future-Dwellers🚀[/h1]

[h3]Remember when we asked for your questions about I Am Future on our Social Media channels and Discord server?[/h3]

We have gathered the questions and are excited to answer them regarding the game's development and upcoming features! 🤖

You can watch the video right here on our YouTube channel or read the below Q&A now.

[previewyoutube=S3ctStWR_so;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Here are the questions and answers from the developers:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/25d1699942433c730c56d5978399e51163cd0d67.png[/img]

[h3][b]Q1 - [/b]Are there going to be human characters or are they all haunted appliances?[/h3]
Cosmopolis is hiding a lot of secrets, including survivors we haven't had a chance to meet yet.

[h3][b]Q2 -[/b] Will there be mod support?[/h3]
We have received numerous requests from the community to add mod support. However, our team wants to gain more experience before implementing such a feature, so we are currently conducting research.

[h3][b]Q3 -[/b] When do we get to kill those big plants and weeds?[/h3]
There will be an opportunity soon for players to interact with those pests.

[h3][b]Q4 -[/b] Will there be more non-biofuel sources of energy?[/h3]
Yes, the plan is to let players use natural energy in the future.

[h3][b]Q5 - [/b]Are we going to be able to go inside the buildings in the future?[/h3]
Yes! We are exploring the possibility of adding an exciting feature for exploring the inside of the buildings below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/b6ea5e4a16da85d0f8a32f365cc3c1d38341443d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Q6 - [/b]Will you be adding a co-op mode soon?[/h3]
Unfortunately, there are no plans to incorporate this.

[h3][b]Q7 -[/b] Will click-to-move ever be supported?[/h3]
We're happy to report that our team is making progress towards controlling characters as we had planned.

[h3][b]Q8 - [/b]Are you going to add an Italian translation?[/h3]
We've received a high demand for the addition of the Italian language so we will be considering this!

[h3][b]Q9 -[/b] What engine was this made in? [/h3]
Unity

[h3][b]Q10 -[/b] What was the inspiration?[/h3]
It's quite a vast subject to discuss. So, we love the theme of the post-apocalypse, which is evident in all our projects. But with I Am Future, we wanted to create a very positive and cozy video game about the post-apocalypse where you have your quiet place with beautiful nature around you. 

Somewhere you can get away from the noise of the city and begin a new peaceful life. 
The head of the studio, Eugene, got this idea when he moved from a big city into a country house during the COVID-19. The movie I Am Legend was also one of the biggest inspirations for our game; as you may remember, in the first half of the movie, the main character is living in the post-apocalypse, not surviving. 

He goes shopping and listens to Bob Marley on his record player—in other words, tries to live a normal life. When it comes to the art style, we were inspired by physical dioramas with destroyed houses overgrown with greenery and half submerged in water. That seemed incredibly beautiful to us, especially considering the fact this theme hadn't been reflected enough in games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/e89c977c9f0740e9bd06f5f46918eb866c41259a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Q11 -[/b] Any plans to be able to build furniture?[/h3]
We're planning to release a pack of decorative constructions, including the ability to rebuild previously disassembled roof objects.

[h3][b]Q12 -[/b] Is there a Mac version planned?[/h3]
It's in our plans for the Version 1.0 release.

[h3][b]Q13 -[/b] Will you be able to patch up the holes in the rooftop floor?[/h3]
Yes! This feature will be available in the future.

[h3][b]Q14 - [/b]Are there any plans for storing large amounts of fresh water, like in a water tank?[/h3]
Of course! We heard your requests and have this planned.

[h3][b]Q15 -[/b] Will the Engineer Minion have any other tasks besides refilling generators?[/h3]
Yes, our team is looking to expand the range of constructions the Engineer Minion maintains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/7549666ca5b7f0de67c0460ad0d4f42ab1094409.png[/img]

[h3][b]Q16 -[/b] Is there consideration for adding a jump command?[/h3]
The location's design is not suitable for implementing a jump feature. Some areas are currently closed off.

[h3][b]Q17 -[/b] What methodology do you guys work with?[/h3]
Our motto is, to work on a project until we're satisfied with it! We try to maintain a healthy and creative atmosphere so that the developers are happy to do their thing. We have weekly sprints and try not to crunch, as it negatively affects the final product.

[h3][b]Q18 - [/b]What does the code release schedule revolve around?[/h3]
The final update schedule will be revealed later; we are already actively working on implementing the new content and mechanics reflected in our roadmap.

[h3][b]Q19 -[/b] Are there any easter eggs in the game?[/h3]
Yes, there are! Can you guess them?

[h3][b]Q20 -[/b] Can we travel across the map later?[/h3]
The game world will be constantly expanding with new rooftop and expedition locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/84fea3a9ae1eecd277782b5ac1948abe9eb828d3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Q21 - [/b]Will there be bigger storage for wood, sheet metal, and glass?[/h3]
Yes, and, in addition to storage—an increased capacity version of the sprinkler

[h3][b]Q22 - [/b]Will we get to build a home instead of sleeping on the lawn chair?[/h3]
So far, we haven't planned for it, but we will add more content to help make your roof feel cozy and homely.

[h3][b]Q23 - [/b]Is the main character based on any of the devs? If so, who is he and why?[/h3]
Our main character embodies the characteristics of each member of the Mandragora team.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]That's all for now, future dwellers![/h3] Thank you for your ongoing support of I Am Future, especially during our Early Access phase as we continue to improve and develop the game.

Leave a comment if you have any questions for future Q&A with the developers.

notes.title: Devlog №6: Robots Helping You Build a Base?
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, future-dwellers![/b][/h1]

Welcome to yet another entry in the [i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i] devlog. In the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1658040/announcements/detail/3705944461986388101]previous one[/url], we talked about fish cutting and Cook Mode—features that will help you keep your stomach full. With your basic needs covered, you can now proceed to construct a comfortable post-apocalyptic base.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/e633f0276f2a0bcdbc83ae39d07882fbecab3133.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/20813e581e04f9d4d885aaff72a74cb0cc060d77.gif[/img]

Structures you can build on your rooftop base are divided into three categories:
[olist]
[*][b]Production structures[/b] include workbenches, biogenerators, campfires, molecular synthesizers, and more. They are meant to produce resources and tools;
[*][b]Defensive structures[/b]—fences and torches—guard your roof against mutated leeches, weeds, and other pests;
[*][b]Auxiliary structures[/b], such as storage, can be built to keep your supplies well-organized.[/olist]
Some structures run solely on electricity, meaning they need to be connected to [b]generators[/b]. The generator uses biomass found on the roof to produce energy. Another electricity-dependent structure is the crypto farm. It provides a special currency, U-coins, that can be used to purchase essential items while exploring the flooded cityscape with a drone. The Resource Printer also needs electricity to work. Printed resources, such as building bridges between roofs, will be useful in late-game construction.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/6141dfa94f6b865ed3fe75c021ddaa3a6d1e487c.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kl4sGZT.gif[/img]

Tending to your base alone in a deserted megalopolis could make you feel lonesome. Worry not, though, future-dweller! The loneliness of the post-apocalypse can be remedied by surrounding yourself with [b]friendly robots[/b]. They will help you with the housework while you kick back and enjoy their company.  

These adorable steel minions have three roles: [b]Collector[/b], [b]Builder[/b], and [b]Technician[/b].
[olist]
[*][b]The Collector[/b] gathers and stores junk, saving you precious time;
[*][b]The Builder[/b] retrieves resources from storage and transports them to construction sites, acting as your trusty construction worker;
[*][b]The Technician[/b] maintains structures that require resources to function. In the future, Technicians will also manage automated irrigation systems and resource printers.[/olist]
Minions operate on energy and can be recharged at designated charging stations. We made sure their recharging feels as relaxing as [strike]humanly[/strike] [i]robotically[/i] possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/daab72a73c3658e1030aeb1af0384cf15942450c.png[/img]

The cuties have [b]automatic[/b] and manual [b]modes[/b], allowing them to choose objects to work with or follow your specific instructions. Additionally, you can customize their colors and adorn them with [b]cool-looking hats[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GGoufFM.jpg[/img]
To create these mechanized helpers, you need to find [b]programmable cores[/b]. It can be done during expeditions or through side quests. 

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Watch the video version of this devlog published by IGN that features something extra: new gameplay of the Cook Mode:[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=x8yW-jSHM6U;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
That's all for today, future-dwellers! Follow [b][i]I Am Future[/i][/b] to stay updated, and don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/iamfuturegame][b]cozy Discord[/b][/url]. See you in the future!

notes.title: Devlog №5: Gourmet in the Post-Apocalypse
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/8cdb53b63c6c1dbd5bbf1c1aaeb6ecdcb4562952.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hi there![/b][/h1]

Welcome to yet another entry in the [i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i] devlog. In the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1658040/announcements/detail/3669908058334218987]previous one[/url], we talked about the 🎣fishing mechanic. Now that you’ve caught a fish, it’s time to cook it! Put on your chef's hat, future-dweller!

[quote][b]Caution! Don’t read this devlog further if you are hungry.[/b][/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/e1d753dc67daf2ff69ba571a36186c217e11db93.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9712cdf5a186fd0a6363301653d7e65eef8484f.png[/img]
The ability to [b]cut fish[/b] has been implemented to make marine dwellers a valuable resource in our game. Each type of fish provides a slightly different loot, offering a diverse range of rewards. Some species yield a generous amount of [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/9458a4e8881fbcd8ff0b33a15584d79344efa7bd.png[/img] fillets[/b], providing a significant source of sustenance. On the other hand, more exotic types offer the prized delicacy of [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/6acf7c154c7c8c72a3558e313c352875bcf4a67e.png[/img] caviar[/b]. Certain gilled denizens even provide [b]resources[/b] essential for crafting. This allows players to strategically target specific fish based on their needs and preferences.

But that's not all, future-dwellers! Engaging in the art of fish cutting may lead to surprises. Occasionally, you may come across [b]❓unique items[/b] that the fish has swallowed in the past. Who knows what hidden treasures await within the belly of a subaqueous being? Keep your eyes peeled for these valuable discoveries as you operate your kitchen knife.

Oh, and one more thing. For those wondering what that "Field Kitchen" thing in the screenshot above is: upgrading your campfire turns it into a legit wood stove!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/794e512901c3a232d6875d2b1661b1f727016a80.png[/img]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4676a6985d4843c3d16473141abddd43f9abe9a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/e1eea3beb728937dd10d9adb72750e34afc2689b.png[/img]
Now that you know a thing or two about preparing food for consumption, how about we delve deeper into that? Living in the post-apocalypse requires decent cooking skills, and that’s exactly what we will talk about next. 

[b]Cook Mode[/b] is a feature that will allow you to cook wholesome food to keep your stomach full. We're envisioning it to be a creative and delightful experience, allowing combining ingredients to discover new recipes. Initially, you'll be able to mix only two types of ingredients. However, as you upgrade your field kitchen, an [b]additional dish slot[/b] will unlock.

We want recipes to be simple and intuitive. For example, you can transform blueberries into delicious jam and then prepare a fresh bun to pair with it. Similarly, combining fish fillets with water creates a flavourful bowl of fish soup. As you unlock new ingredients, you will be able to combine them with the old ones to access even more tantalizing cooking formulas. Once a recipe is discovered, you can cook it using the campfire. 

We plan on adding around [b]20 different dishes[/b] on release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c5b7e1f9b0ae17706bf2cb9c199d1ef06eb6632f.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
That's all for today, future-dwellers! Follow [b][i]I Am Future[/i][/b] to stay updated, and don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/iamfuturegame][b]cozy Discord[/b][/url]. See you in the future!

notes.title: Devlog №3: Thank You for Your Demo Feedback!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pDeIuD9.gif[/img]

[h1]Hey, future-dwellers![/h1]

It's time to look back at the launch of our demo and assess the results! Steam Next Fest ended this Monday; the demo was battle-tested and received tons of feedback from the players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/0a287c9d969dfc6c1602b43b44e9ab7e59446948.png[/img]

We have to admit it was a little intense to prepare for our first public demo release, but the result turned out to be awesome. Almost [b]50 thousand players[/b] tried the [i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i] demo version, and the numbers keep growing daily! 

Having a lot of players obviously means getting a lot of feedback, right? Comments and suggestions from our community appear on our forums faster than weeds on your rooftop! Whoops, not the best comparison, but you get the meaning.😅 

We’d like to warmly thank each and every one of you for sharing your ideas and suggestions. For us, it will be a busy couple of months processing the feedback and making incremental improvements to the game. As you probably remember, it is coming to Steam Early Access on May 18th, so before that, we've got to implement the key suggestions and make sure they synergize together.

[b]We can already say with certainty that we will add/tweak the following features/mechanics:[/b]

[olist]
[*] [b]Hunger [/b](buffing the effect of some foods)
[*] [b]Fishing [/b](adding a more detailed tutorial, polish the process of fishing)
[*] [b]Controller support & key rebinding[/b] (adding to the Early Access version of the game)
[*] [b]Inventory management[/b] (making improvements)
[/olist]

During the pre-Early Access launch period, we plan to hold one or two closed playtests on our [url=https://discord.gg/iamfuturegame][b]Discord server[/b][/url]. It would involve testing the full version of the game, not the demo. For that, we will select a small group of players and provide them access to the work-in-progress build.

[h3]Now, how about some teasers, future-dwellers?[/h3]

One of the most interesting mechanics we're hard at work on is [b]Expeditions[/b]. You've already had a chance to get a glimpse of it in the recent demo. However, today we want to tell you a little more about it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/d9c6c9f492d5326adf474ec1fb37c900d687fa56.gif[/img]

The diorama you see above shows one of the locations you will be able to explore while embarking on expeditions. It's a sunken plane that conceals valuable resources/items and... secrets. The crash site will be interactable: by rotating the diorama, you will discover fascinating details and parts of the plane (debris, wing, cabin, lavatory, etc.) Text events will guide you through the examination process as you are trying to complete a quest. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DTA0WqM.gif[/img]

But wait, there's more to it. In some of these locations, you will find [b]NPCs[/b] you're going to be able to bring to your base and have them help you build it!


[quote][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/55930d9db823bee5d5878ddeb37229aa567a0ed3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/7aa943a1ed61447b2457ffded2c443844f6ed184.png[/img][/url][/quote]
One more thing, folks. You might have noticed that the little robot guy from our main artwork [i](see the clickable image above)[/i] wasn't in the demo. Wondering what he is doing? Well, he is there to help you automate your routine! You will be able to [b]program your little helpers[/b] to water crops, gather resources, cook, fish, exterminate leeches and do all sorts of tasks! We will tell you more about it in one of our upcoming devlogs.


That wraps it up for today's entry, folks. Follow I Am Future to stay updated: in the next devlogs, we will cover more interesting aspects of the game. Also, join our [url=https://discord.gg/iamfuturegame][b]cozy Discord[/b][/url] to get notified about future closed beta tests.

notes.content:
[quote][quote][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ci2Zm1q.gif[/img][/quote]
[h1]Hey there again, everyone![/h1]

[i]We have a big year ahead of us: with our eyes set firmly on releasing the game this year in Early Access, the team continues to work hard on [i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i]. This work has already borne fruit: we released a demo earlier this week to let players get their hands on the game early and gather feedback. One of the mechanics this demo is built around is [b]disassembly[/b]. In today's devlog entry, we would like to tell you more about it.[/i][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/a8c9f3ec308f4fda9114198448d35faedd4e8cac.png[/img]

Luckily, since you’re supposedly the only human on the entire planet, you will experience no shortage of resources. In [b][i]I Am Future[/i][/b], everything around you is up for grabs, including all kinds of household appliances from the long-gone civilization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/47e7711b0810108e9ff67c3a3e0e7ef0bf93c735.png[/img]

First, let’s talk about how we came up with adding the disassembly mechanic to [i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i]. In a survival game, the player constantly needs various resources for crafting and building. Our team wants to breathe life into the process of resource gathering and ensure that each disassembly feels like a small adventure rather than a tedious chore. Our goal is to make each mini-puzzle challenging yet intuitive enough, so players will have the chance to learn a little bit more about electronics along the way.

So how does disassembly actually work? Each appliance has parts that are attached to the frame. You rotate it, locating detachable parts and removing them in a specific order. You can’t remove the lid without unscrewing it, can you? It’s important to point out that, by disassembling an appliance, you might get both basic and unique materials that otherwise would be hard to come across.

[quote][img]https://i.imgur.com/inXzftf.gif[/img][/quote]

Sometimes you will be in for a surprise too. Who knows what an ancient microwave may contain—a hidden stash or even a tiny civilization that has developed in a dried-up drop of soup?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/6aca8f349db9f56770f6d256a0a5ac22c853403d.png[/img]

We are currently working on quite an extensive list of disassemblable appliances. Among them: a TV set, a flashlight, a fan, a vacuum cleaner, a game controller and Christmas lights. The game is a story-driven experience, so some items will have stories to tell of what had happened to them before they ended up in the player’s hands.

notes.title: Devlog №1: Flooded Cities, Megacorps and... Talking Fridges?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/de2783758ee215309a2531649877ded1556715ff.png[/img]

[h1]Greetings from Mandragora, the team behind I Am Future![/h1]

[quote][i]As [i][b]I Am Future[/b][/i] is steadily shaping up, we decided to start telling you a little more about the development process and ideas/features that we implement. In our series of devlogs, we will dive deep into how our upcoming survival life sim is being created. The topic of our first devlog entry is [b]the lore[/b] of the game. Let's jump right in.[/i][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/ecc2cc2f0835ffd15384e41604a1904dab88a583.png[/img]

[b]The events of [b][i]I Am Future[/i][/b] take place on the post-apocalyptic Earth, where human civilization is shattered and almost extinct. [/b]
[hr][/hr]The series of incidents that led to the collapse of society began when the comet that flew out from the Kuiper Belt was accidentally caught by the Earth's gravity and became another satellite of our planet. The series of earthquakes, tsunamis, and climate change that followed led to the rise of the global sea level, flooding numerous cities and territories occupied by billions of people. 

The remains of humankind then united under the rule of [b]The United Federation of Earth[/b]: a police state with a technocratic government settled in [b]Cosmopolis[/b], a magnificent capital one step short of becoming a utopia. However, society soon became infested with ragtag cults and radical groups that saw the second satellite as an omen of extinction, while others tried using it to their advantage. The conditions on Earth became harsher and harsher, with the constant increase in the cost of living for most of the population. Desperation spread.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/d7c04250fc2c120a7f6c237fa7d4fd5345410a52.png[/img]

It is a time of the corporate struggle between three rising conglomerates, all striving to break through the human body's limitations in their search for immortality. The ideas of Transhumanism became the epitome of thoughts and aspirations of all—from commoners struggling to survive another day to overindulged billionaires worrying about their deteriorating bodies.

Theseustech Corporation offers to substitute the human brain with an artificial brain implant which would then be transplanted into an android body granting immortality to the owner, given that the necessary maintenance will take place. This is a long, painful, and costly procedure that only some of the wealthiest members of society can afford. 

Neolife tackles the problem of immortality differently—they set out to create a digital haven where the people’s consciousness will be living a happy and fulfilling life free of earthly struggles and the need to take care of their corporeal bodies in the first place. The option to digitize the consciousness becomes an extremely popular choice for most people, including the poorest members of society. Undergoing this procedure to become a sentient service android or even a home appliance promises massive monetary compensation to their families. You can bump into a talking fridge across abandoned residences here and there, and now you know it’s not just a program, but someone’s identity caught within the appliance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/a36954c408997a93481a02d427a858686270376a.png[/img]

Devus Ink pursues the colonization of other planets to attain more valuable resources there. However, the expeditions don’t go quite as planned and become more and more costly. 

Eventually, after a brutal confrontation accompanied by hostile mergers and failed mega-projects, the winner is forged. This is [b]UNICORP[/b]: a massive conglomerate that becomes the largest and the most influential company of its time, pulling the strings of every meaningful resource and politician in the government behind the scenes.

[quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/7551726089642c36da778cb7262ba5253a752298.png[/img][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/8843a7f3db705eda4a0a7980984b047cdba64ee6.png[/img]

This is where your story begins. You find yourself in a ruined city, your memory has been modified, and anything you do remember gives you no clear picture of the events that preceded the catastrophic destruction surrounding you. There are no signs of city inhabitants and no presence of UNICORP activities. Where is everyone? What has happened here? The city lies in shattered ruins; it is up to you to reveal the chain of cataclysmic events behind this and learn our hero's true identity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4ae5ad4099de3115235181ac668536fd8d7386fe.png[/img]

[h3]About the game:[/h3]

Stretch yourself after hibernation, summer is here![b] I Am Future is a survival sandbox game with a refreshingly upbeat vibe. Expect to experience a mix of survival features, dynamic graphics and mysterious stories in this gorgeous futuristic post-apocalyptic world.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yHM5h8U.gif[/img]

Waking up from hibernation as a guy named Christopher, you find yourself alone on the top of a skyscraper in this seemingly abandoned world called Cosmopolis. While civilization may have collapsed, your intelligence and creativity can help build yourself a new home from scratch. 

[h3][b][u]Take a deep breath and enjoy what this world has to offer:[/u][/b][/h3]

[h3][b]- Abundant resources to fill your stomach![/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5aftjam.gif[/img]

Harvest mushrooms, lettuce leaves and more to cook delicious meals. You will not be able to survive with an empty stomach, let alone recreating a cozy home.

[h3][b]- Tools, gadgets and space for you to build a personalized base.[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ApHS7TH.gif[/img]

Turn the empty roof into a custom place for work and for recreation. Research new technologies to aid yourself, collect an assortment of tool attachments for your multifunctional bionic arm and automate the housekeeping with the help of a swarm of cheery little helper robots.

[h3][b]- New friends, an exciting map and plenty of new hobbies![/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DrmzD6W.gif[/img]

Did that fridge just talk? Upload the AI to objects around you when you feel like you are losing your sanity. Develop some surprising friendships by sharing your thoughts, and listening to theirs.  From the comfort of home, send out drones to explore the ruins or wander around the cosmopolis yourself. Explore your hidden talents in fishing, farming or gardening, you have lots of time now!

[h3][b]- Unknown menaces and captivating mysteries![/b][/h3]

Whatever tore the world apart is still around. Protect the new utopia you’re building from these strange menaces. Construct defenses and prepare yourself for battle at night, then reap the rewards come daybreak. 

How did you get into hibernation and why did you end up on a roof? Where is everyone else and what ruined civilization? The answers lay somewhere in the city ruins - would you try to get to the bottom of it?
